== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* First reached Challenger on EUW at the age of 14
* His ID was created accidentally when he tried to type "Crazy"
* Started playing League of Legends during Season 2
* Had reached Rank 1 on EUNE
* His favorite professional AD carry players are [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], [[Deft]], and [[Rekkles]]
* Used to be {{ci|Riven}} one-trick pony
* Started playing AD carry after his team benched their AD and nobody wanted to play the role
* First Player with [[Humanoid]] from the Czech Republic to win the LEC title.
* Reached 1000 kills in the LEC on September 09, 2023.
** The 12th player to reach 1000 kills in the LEC after [[Rekkles]], [[Jankos]], [[Perkz]], [[nukeduck]], [[Caps]], [[Wunder]], [[Kobbe]], [[Hans sama]], [[Odoamne]], [[Upset]], and [[Larssen]].
